review_description: Original installer not answering phone and sungrow are no help at all

I was quoted on the 5/1 and paid a deposit on the 8th I was well informed about the processed and Adrian the sales guy answered my questions clearly and was well informed. I was given a week notice on when the installation was to take place and the system was installed within the day. The system is producing more than the daily average I was told however it's been very hot the last few days.Im happy with the outcome and cant wait to see the savings.

Really professional team. It took a while to get it installed but that was due to South Australia Power Networks taking about 6 weeks to approve it so entirely out of All States hands. Really happy with the system and the team couldnt be easier to work with.
